name: omnisense/omnifilm
description: Omnifilm: the record of a film, a series or an episode under any PHP host, whoever keeps it - titles, dates, cast and crew, pictures, identifiers across registers (IMDb, TMDB, TheTVDB, Trakt, Wikidata), a season's episodes and where to watch, behind contracts by capability. Providers are packages of their own (omnifilm/tmdb, omnifilm/omdb, omnifilm/tvdb, omnifilm/trakt, omnifilm/wikidata); the Symfony and Laravel bridges live in omnibridge.

suggest.omnifilm/tmdb: The Movie Database: search, records with cast and pictures, episodes, where to watch (JustWatch's data)
suggest.omnifilm/omdb: OMDb: records by IMDb number with IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic ratings
suggest.omnifilm/tvdb: TheTVDB: series and their episodes, films
suggest.omnifilm/trakt: Trakt: records and episodes, identifiers across registers
suggest.omnifilm/wikidata: Wikidata: open records (CC0) and identifiers across registers, no key
suggest.omnisense/omnibridge: The host contracts; omnibridge/symfony and omnibridge/laravel wire omnifilm into their host when a site needs it
